title: Open counit expansion of a restricted scalar transpose
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes are separated of finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On either the ordinary etale or pro-etale site let $\mathcal C_{T,R}=D^b_{ctf}(T,R)$ mean the full category of constant-$R$ module complexes with bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude: tensor with any degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology in one fixed finite interval [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude, det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer]. Write $T_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].
Let $f:X\to Y$ be any separated finite-type morphism and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ a quasi-compact open immersion; put $g=fj$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Choose compactifications with separated finite-type middle schemes [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the pro-etale finite-Tor categories write $F_{h,R}=Rh_{!,R}\dashv G_{h,R}=h_R^!$ with counit $\epsilon_{h,R}$, for $h=f,g$ and $R=A,B$ [sk-prop-sf-rf-shriek-preservation]. Let $J_R=Dj_{!,R}\dashv U_R=j_R^*$ have its actual open counit $v_R$ [det-sf-mate-open-restriction], and use the canonical adjunction-preserving composition and refinement comparisons $F_{g,R}=F_{f,R}J_R$, $G_{g,R}=U_RG_{f,R}$ [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility]. Let $b_f:T_YF_{f,A}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{f,B}T_X$ and $b_j:T_XJ_A\xrightarrow{\sim}J_BT_U$ be the specified proper-counit/open-tensor maps [det-sp-reduction-direct-image], using the identity proper compactification to normalize $b_j$. Let $a_j:T_UU_A\xrightarrow{\sim}U_BT_X$ be the canonical scalar/restriction isomorphism [def-sp-constant-scalar-pullback-comparison].
Fix $K\in\mathcal C_{Y,A}$, put $M=G_{f,A}K$ and $L=U_AM$, and let $r:T_XM\to G_{f,B}T_YK$ be any morphism satisfying
$$\epsilon_{f,B,T_YK}\circ F_{f,B}(r)=T_Y(\epsilon_{f,A,K})\circ b_f(M)^{-1}.$$
Define $d=U_B(r)\circ a_{j,M}:T_UL\to G_{g,B}T_YK$ and its counit transpose $\tau=\epsilon_{g,B,T_YK}\circ F_{g,B}(d)$. Then
$$v_{B,T_XM}\circ J_B(a_{j,M})=T_X(v_{A,M})\circ b_j(L)^{-1},$$
and
$$\begin{aligned}
\tau
&=\epsilon_{f,B,T_YK}\circ F_{f,B}(r)\circ F_{f,B}\bigl(v_{B,T_XM}\circ J_B(a_{j,M})\bigr)\\
&=T_Y(\epsilon_{f,A,K})\circ b_f(M)^{-1}\circ F_{f,B}(T_X(v_{A,M}))\circ F_{f,B}(b_j(L)^{-1}).
\end{aligned}$$
Both lines for $\tau$ are morphisms $F_{g,B}T_UL\to T_YK$. The assertion uses the actual open counit and the named scalar/restriction map; it assumes neither invertibility of $r$ nor smoothness of $f$, nor flatness of $B$ over $A$.

proof.text: Use the proved openScalarIso_unit in OpenScalarExchange for the specified canonical comparison of composite left adjoints [def-sp-open-scalar-operations]. In a general square of adjunctions, apply the B open Hom equivalence to the desired counit equation. Its left side transposes to a_j, by the triangle identity. The right side transposes, using the unit equation, to S_U(eta_A) followed by a_j at J_A U_A M and U_B S_X(v_A). Naturality of a_j moves v_A past a_j; the A right triangle identity cancels eta_A followed by U_A(v_A). This is the private proved helper counitOfUnit. The recorded directImageScalarPullbackIso and tensorPullbackIso are definitionally equal (private directImageTensorIso). Specialize at M=(GA.obj K).obj. This proves the first conjunct without any etale/pro-etale site transport.

The definition openScalarRestrictedTranspose already uses the inverse Hom equivalence for the composite adjunction coordinates [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. Apply Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm to a_j followed by U_B(r), then Adjunction.homEquiv_counit to a_j. Preservation of composition by F_f and associativity give the first expansion. This is the private proved helper inverseTransposeExpansion.

Substitute the first conjunct into the open factor of the first expansion, distribute F_f over the resulting composite, and substitute hr for F_f(r) followed by the f counit. Associativity gives precisely the second expansion. The private proved helper mapCompSubstitute performs these substitutions in an arbitrary category. No inverse of r and no geometric or coefficient-flatness hypothesis is used.

lean.note: The three equations are stated in the stipulated adjunction-preserving composition coordinates F_g=J followed by F_f and G_g=G_f followed by restriction. The helper defines tau by the actual open inverse Hom equivalence followed by F_f and its counit, exactly the composite-adjunction inverse Hom equivalence. J is the normalized ringed open extension; reductionOpenModel identifies the recorded sectionwise extension with these coordinates, and b_j is the prescribed openScalarIso there. The named scalar/restriction map is directImageScalarPullbackIso.inv; b_f is exactly reductionDirectImageComparison. Membership and invertibility certificates only make the recorded full-category adjunction and its specified inverse well typed. No arbitrary scalar map, smoothness, flatness or invertibility of r is assumed. The added landed dependency owns the already existing intrinsic finite-Tor full category, avoiding its duplication.
